incident_count.description: Count incident tickets in the service desk.

incident_minutes.description: Total incident handling minutes for a loyalty tier of customers having at least one posted order. Count each ticket once.

dashboard_orders.description: Count unique order IDs observed in the dashboard export, where item observations can repeat.

posted_item_orders.description: Count posted orders that contain an SKU and whose customer belongs to a loyalty tier.

net_collections.description: Compute posted net collections in cents under the Finance policy effective on the date of each order. Subtract settled credits only under v2.

collections_delta.description: Difference in posted net collections between the first brand and then other_brand. A negative difference is valid.

partner_share.description: Share of posted orders placed by marketplace partners as a percentage. An unavailable buyer to partner mapping yields missing_relationship.

resolve_review_case.description: Set an open incident review case to resolved. Only supervisor with approved case can perform this action. A closed case stays closed.
